title: Valletta and the Great Siege of Malta with Dan Snow
description: Historian Dan Snow narrates a walk through Valletta from the Triton Fountain, telling the story of the 1565 siege and how the knights built a new fortress city on the peninsula afterward.

title: Valletta’s Secrets and the Heritage of the Knights: A Walking Tour
description: A licensed Maltese guide leads a walk from the city gate down Republic Street, past the Parliament, the Co-Cathedral, and the Grandmaster’s Palace, ending at the lift down to the harbor.

title: Valletta’s Legacy: A Tour from the Cruise Port to President’s Palace
description: A walk up from the cruise terminal on the Grand Harbour into the city, through the gardens and bastions to the Grandmaster’s Palace, now the office of the president.
